input.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Company
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot be blocked from assigning to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and a change of control should not give Contractor any termination or re-pricing right. Consent for other assignments remains subject to the existing reasonableness standard.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld; provided that Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganisation or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and no change of control of Company shall constitute an assignment or give Contractor any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.

input.summary: Add Company ownership of Company data and materials
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 4 vests the Works in us but says nothing about the data and materials we supply, and Section 4(b)(ii) sweeps records "relating to the Services" to Contractor. We have added a short confirmation that we retain all rights in Company data and materials and that no rights in them transfer to Contractor.

ops.text: Company retains all right, title and interest in and to all data, content and materials provided or made available by Company or generated for Company in the course of the Services ("Company Data"), and nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to Contractor any ownership of Company Data or of Company's other intellectual property. No Works or Company Data shall be jointly owned.
